claim: Someone who assumes a scripted recorder only works on simple server-rendered pages will believe DemoKit drives one of the heaviest apps on the web - a WebGL map streaming vector tiles into a virtualised result feed - and can still prove what each step put on screen.
_ledger: S0  Google Maps over downtown San Francisco, 16z                 <- where the viewer starts
S1  every restaurant nearby, pinned on the canvas and listed beside it <- click the Restaurants chip
S2  the filter sheet: price, rating, hours, cuisine                    <- click All filters

steps.label: search the map
steps.shows: every restaurant nearby - pinned on the canvas, listed beside it

steps.label: open the filters
steps.shows: price, rating, opening hours and cuisine, all of it live against the map
